plain_english: Passion, aversion, pleasure, displeasure, rise and fall, I-ness, misery and the rest — things shining forth, universe-bodied, are not different-natured. Whosever manifestation you suddenly see — having regarded it as one-self-natured consciousness-form — why do you not delight, full of contemplation?
sanskrit_cite: rāga dveṣa sukha asukha udaya laya ahaṃkāra dainya ādayo ye bhāvāḥ pravibhānti viśvavapuṣo bhinnasvabhāvā | na te vyaktiṃ paśyasi yasya yasya sahasā tattattat ekātmatā saṃvidrūpam avekṣya kiṃ na ramase tad bhāvanānirbharaḥ
